observed with ALMA on the 1st of May 2016

method.value: Masked moment technique with spatial Gaussian and velocity Hanning smoothing, 1.5 sigma threshold; H2 mass from CO flux

method.value: KinMS models fitted to whole cube with MCMC (Gibbs sampling, adaptive stepping), full analytic covariance matrix likelihood, LDL^T factorisation

evidence.quote: we utilize an MCMC method with Gibbs sampling and adaptive stepping to explore the parameter space

key_parameters.value: 10 free parameters; priors flat, SMBH mass flat in log between 10^4.8 and 10^9.8 Msun; M/L 0.1-4.0; final chain 10^5 steps, 10% burn-in

evidence.quote: we ran the best chain 10$^5$ steps (with a 10% burn-in) to produce our final posterior probability distribution

assumptions.value: Exponential gas disc, purely circular motion, spatially constant velocity dispersion

evidence.quote: In this work we always assume that the gas is in circular motion

fitting.value: Log-likelihood from chi2 with full covariance matrix; best fit is median of the marginalised posterior; 68 and 99% CL

evidence.quote: We use a standard logarithmic likelihood function based on the $\chi^2$ distribution

evidence.quote: These tests showed that our algorithm performs well, and finds the same best-fit values and parameter ranges.

findings_qualitative.value: Mm continuum is thermal dust emission, co-spatial with the gas disc.

evidence.quote: Overall it seems that the millimetre continuum we detect is thermal in origin

claims.hypothesis: Can molecular gas kinematics measure the SMBH mass in NGC4697 and agree with stellar dynamics?
claims.experiment: Forward-model the ALMA CO(2-1) cube with KinMS and MCMC
claims.result: M_BH = 1.3e8 Msun (+0.18/-0.17), versus 1.6e8 from stellar kinematics
claims.finding: Gas-based mass is consistent with stellar-kinematic measurements

evidence.quote: Our estimate of the SMBH mass is entirely consistent with previous measurements from stellar kinematics.

claims.hypothesis: Is the result robust to systematics?
claims.experiment: Vary the circular velocity by ±10%, include the AGN point source, test dispersion gradients
claims.result: M_BH unchanged for ±10% velocity scaling; point source gives 9.3e7
claims.finding: Mass is robust, with 0.1 dex added to the error

evidence.quote: the SMBH mass we derive remains constant at (1.3$_{-0.14}^{+0.18}$)$\times$10$^8$ M$_{\odot}$.

claims.hypothesis: Why is the gas velocity dispersion so low?
claims.experiment: Refit the 3 km/s cube and sample GMC mass functions with Larson relations
claims.result: sigma_gas = 1.65 km/s; random GMC draws always give >3 km/s
claims.finding: An unsampled GMC mass function partly explains it, but other mechanisms are likely needed

evidence.quote: we still cannot fully explain the low dispersion observed.

why_this_method.value: Figure-of-merit criterion indicated the data suffice for an SMBH mass

evidence.quote: suggesting we should be able to accurately constrain the SMBH mass in this system.
